problem:
The acceleration $a$ at time $t$ of a particle $P$ moving in the $xy$-plane is given by

$$
a(t)=⟨48(2t+1)^{2},\,-6⟩.
$$

Given that the particle is at the position $(2,-1)$ and has velocity $⟨8,\,5⟩$ when $t=0,$ calculate the position vector of $P$ at time $t.$

$r(t)=⟨${{field-1}}$,\,-3{t}^{2}+5t-1\,⟩$
